Debasish Padhy

PROFILE SUMMARY

Accomplished Data Engineering professional with 8+ years of experience driving enterprise-

scale data architecture and cloud transformation initiatives across Azure and GCP ecosystems. Proven expertise in designing and optimizing scalable, high-performance data pipelines leveraging PySpark, Databricks, and distributed computing frameworks for large-scale data processing. Strong track record in data platform modernization and ETL/ELT strategy, enabling seamless migration from legacy systems to cloud-native, cost-efficient architectures.  Adept at translating complex business requirements into data-driven solutions, delivering actionable insights through advanced analytics, KPI frameworks, and visualization tools like Power BI.





Demonstrated leadership in DataOps, CI/CD implementation, and workflow orchestration, ensuring robust, automated, and reliable data ecosystems using tools like Airflow and Azure DevOps. Recognized for stakeholder engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and team mentorship, driving project success while fostering best practices in data engineering and governance.



WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Data Engineer Cimpress India Private Limited | Bengaluru, India Sep 2023 – Present 

Spearhead optimization of large-scale data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt, reducing runtime and compute costs through innovative incremental models.  Architect and implement incremental processing frameworks, cutting refresh times



to one-sixth of full load duration, boosting operational efficiency. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, metric alignment, and root-cause resolution for production issues.

Develop and automate reporting pipelines for business reviews, streamlining



communication and improving consistency across stakeholders. Lead initiatives to create reusable Python packages with CI/CD capabilities, standardizing deployment across the engineering team.

Mentor junior engineers on data engineering best practices, CI/CD, and cloud workflows, accelerating onboarding and integration.

Drive NLP-based keyword extraction pipelines for communication data, delivering





actionable insights for strategic decisions. Enhance data models and analytics explores, improving operational and leadership reporting capabilities. Implement robust data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance and high data quality across all assets.

Develop and Integrate conversation slack bots with Snowflake cortex AI , enabling stakeholders to interact with data without manual intervention.

Key Achievements:  Achieved 10x runtime reduction for large-scale data processing, delivering

substantial cost savings.

Automated reporting workflows, eliminating manual effort and improving consistency.

Developed a concurrency algorithm for phone call analytics, now a key operational



metric. Implemented a new data architecture design, enhancing accessibility and usability across business units.

 Recognized for innovative problem-solving and exceptional contributions by senior

management.

● Power BI (KPI dashboards)

Data Science



Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning

Transformers, LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI
